anomalies.expected: The LM1117 datasheet requires a minimum output capacitor of 10µF (tantalum) or 22µF (aluminum) for stability. C2 should be at least 10µF.
anomalies.impact: The 5V rail may be unstable or oscillate, causing unreliable operation of the ATtiny microcontrollers and other 5V logic.

anomalies.observed: R3 is specified as 10M, acting as a pull-up on the RST net.
anomalies.expected: A typical external reset pull-up for an AVR (ATtiny45/ATtiny13) is 10K. 10M is three orders of magnitude too high to provide effective noise immunity or a defined logic level if the internal pull-up is disabled.
anomalies.impact: The reset line is weakly pulled high, making the board susceptible to noise-induced resets or failure to start if the internal pull-up is not sufficient.
